# cli/cli

> Command-line parsing: flags, arguments, subcommands and generated --help.

truck [cli](../cli.md) · [source](../../../registry/cli/cli.pkg)

```
let c = cli_new("pkget", "download Packenger packages")
cli_flag(c, "verbose", "v", "say what is happening")
cli_opt(c, "out", "o", "DIR", "where to put them", "pkgs")
cli_num(c, "jobs", "j", "N", "downloads at once", 4)
cli_arg(c, "package", "a package name, like std/if")
cli_rest(c, "more", "more packages")
if !cli_parse(c, argv)
  return cli_status(c)
end
print cli_str(c, "out")
print vec_len(cli_args(c))
```

**Declaring**: each takes the parser first. Flag names are what follows
`--`; the short name is one letter (or `""` for none).

| function | declares |
|---|---|
| `cli_new(name: str, about: str) -> ptr Cli` | a parser for a program |
| `cli_flag(c, name, short, help)` | a switch: `--verbose`, `-v`, `--no-verbose` |
| `cli_opt(c, name, short, meta, help, def: str)` | a string: `--out DIR`, `--out=DIR`, `-o DIR`, `-oDIR` |
| `cli_num(c, name, short, meta, help, def: int)` | an integer, the same ways |
| `cli_arg(c, name, help)`, `cli_arg_opt(c, name, help)` | a positional argument, required or optional, in order |
| `cli_rest(c, name, help)` | any number of further arguments |
| `cli_cmd(c, name, about) -> ptr Cli` | a subcommand, with its own flags and arguments |

**Parsing**: `cli_parse(c, argv) -> bool` reads the program's arguments
(`argv[0]`, the program, is skipped). Flags may come before, between or
after the arguments; `--` ends the flags; `-abc` is `-a -b -c` when they
are switches. The first argument that names a subcommand switches to
it, and flags it doesn't know are looked up in its parents. It returns
false when the program should stop: after printing the help for `-h` or
`--help` (status 0), or an error and a hint to stderr (status 2), such
as `pkget: unknown flag --colour`. `cli_status(c)` is that status, and
`cli_parse_or_exit(c, argv)` exits with it.

**Reading**:

| function | gives |
|---|---|
| `cli_bool(c, name) -> bool`, `cli_str(c, name) -> str`, `cli_int(c, name) -> int` | a flag's value (its default if not given) |
| `cli_given(c, name) -> bool` | was the flag on the command line |
| `cli_get(c, name) -> str` | a positional argument by name, or `""` |
| `cli_args(c) -> ptr Vec` | every positional argument (`str`s), the rest included |
| `cli_command(c) -> str` | the chosen subcommand's name, or `""` |
| `cli_sub(c) -> ptr Cli` | the chosen subcommand's parser (`c` itself if none), to read its flags and arguments |
| `cli_usage(c) -> str` | the help text |

Asking for a flag that wasn't declared stops the program with an
error, since it's a mistake in the program, not in its arguments.

## Library code

Merged into every program that uses this package.

```
const CLI_BOOL = 0
const CLI_STR = 1
const CLI_INT = 2

struct CliFlag
  name: str
  short: str
  kind: int
  meta: str
  help: str
  sval: str
  ival: int
  bval: bool
  given: bool
  def: str
end

struct CliArg
  name: str
  help: str
  required: bool
  rest: bool
end

struct Cli
  name: str
  about: str
  path: str
  flags: ptr Vec
  specs: ptr Vec
  cmds: ptr Vec
  parent: ptr Cli
  chosen: ptr Cli
  args: ptr Vec
  status: int
end

fn cli_new(name: str, about: str) -> ptr Cli
  let c = new Cli
  c.name = name
  c.path = name
  c.about = about
  c.flags = vec_new()
  c.specs = vec_new()
  c.cmds = vec_new()
  c.args = vec_new()
  return c
end

fn cli_add(c: ptr Cli, name: str, short: str, kind: int, meta: str, help: str) -> ptr CliFlag
  let f = new CliFlag
  f.name = name
  f.short = short
  f.kind = kind
  f.meta = meta
  f.help = help
  vec_push(c.flags, f as int)
  return f
end

fn cli_flag(c: ptr Cli, name: str, short: str, help: str)
  cli_add(c, name, short, CLI_BOOL, "", help)
end

fn cli_opt(c: ptr Cli, name: str, short: str, meta: str, help: str, def: str)
  let f = cli_add(c, name, short, CLI_STR, meta, help)
  f.sval = def
  f.def = def
end

fn cli_num(c: ptr Cli, name: str, short: str, meta: str, help: str, def: int)
  let f = cli_add(c, name, short, CLI_INT, meta, help)
  f.ival = def
  f.def = str_from_int(def)
end

fn cli_spec(c: ptr Cli, name: str, help: str, required: bool, rest: bool)
  let a = new CliArg
  a.name = name
  a.help = help
  a.required = required
  a.rest = rest
  vec_push(c.specs, a as int)
end

fn cli_arg(c: ptr Cli, name: str, help: str)
  cli_spec(c, name, help, true, false)
end

fn cli_arg_opt(c: ptr Cli, name: str, help: str)
  cli_spec(c, name, help, false, false)
end

fn cli_rest(c: ptr Cli, name: str, help: str)
  cli_spec(c, name, help, false, true)
end

fn cli_cmd(c: ptr Cli, name: str, about: str) -> ptr Cli
  let s = cli_new(name, about)
  s.parent = c
  s.path = str_concat3(c.path, " ", name)
  vec_push(c.cmds, s as int)
  return s
end

// cli_find looks a flag up by long or short name in c and its parents.
fn cli_find(c: ptr Cli, name: str, short: bool) -> ptr CliFlag
  let p = c
  while p != null
    for i = 0 to vec_len(p.flags) - 1
      let f = vec_get(p.flags, i) as ptr CliFlag
      if !short && f.name == name || short && f.short == name && name != ""
        return f
      end
    end
    p = p.parent
  end
  return null
end

fn cli_must(c: ptr Cli, name: str) -> ptr CliFlag
  let f = cli_find(c, name, false)
  if f == null
    io_err(str_concat4(c.name, ": the program asked for flag --", name, ", which it never declared\n"))
    os_exit(2)
  end
  return f
end

fn cli_root(c: ptr Cli) -> ptr Cli
  let p = c
  while p.parent != null
    p = p.parent
  end
  return p
end

// cli_error prints an error for the subcommand in use and a hint.
fn cli_error(c: ptr Cli, msg: str) -> bool
  io_err(str_concat4(cli_root(c).name, ": ", msg, "\n"))
  io_err(str_concat3("Run '", c.path, " --help' for usage.\n"))
  cli_root(c).status = 2
  return false
end

// cli_set gives a flag a value from the command line.
fn cli_set(c: ptr Cli, f: ptr CliFlag, shown: str, v: str) -> bool
  f.given = true
  if f.kind == CLI_STR
    f.sval = v
    return true
  end
  let ok = false
  let n = str_parse_int(v, &ok)
  if !ok
    return cli_error(c, str_concat4(shown, ": ", str_quote(v), " is not a whole number"))
  end
  f.ival = n
  return true
end

fn cli_parse_or_exit(c: ptr Cli, args: [str])
  if !cli_parse(c, args)
    os_exit(cli_status(c))
  end
end

fn cli_status(c: ptr Cli) -> int
  return cli_root(c).status
end

fn cli_parse(c: ptr Cli, args: [str]) -> bool
  let cur = c
  c.chosen = c
  let flags_done = false
  let i = 1
  while i < len(args)
    let a = args[i]
    i = i + 1
    if !flags_done && a == "--"
      flags_done = true
    elif !flags_done && (a == "-h" || a == "--help")
      io_out(cli_usage(cur))
      io_flush()
      cli_root(c).status = 0
      return false
    elif !flags_done && str_starts(a, "--")
      let body = str_slice(a, 2, len(a))
      let eq = str_find_byte(body, '=', 0)
      let name = body
      let val = ""
      if eq >= 0
        name = str_slice(body, 0, eq)
        val = str_slice(body, eq + 1, len(body))
      end
      let f = cli_find(cur, name, false)
      if f == null && str_starts(name, "no-") && eq < 0
        let g = cli_find(cur, str_slice(name, 3, len(name)), false)
        if g != null && g.kind == CLI_BOOL
          g.bval = false
          g.given = true
          continue
        end
      end
      if f == null
        return cli_error(cur, str_concat("unknown flag --", name))
      end
      if f.kind == CLI_BOOL
        if eq >= 0
          if val == "true"
            f.bval = true
          elif val == "false"
            f.bval = false
          else
            return cli_error(cur, str_concat4("--", name, " is a switch: give it alone, or =true or =false, not =", val))
          end
        else
          f.bval = true
        end
        f.given = true
      else
        if eq < 0
          if i >= len(args)
            return cli_error(cur, str_concat3("--", name, str_concat3(" needs a value (", f.meta, ")")))
          end
          val = args[i]
          i = i + 1
        end
        if !cli_set(cur, f, str_concat("--", name), val)
          return false
        end
      end
    elif !flags_done && str_starts(a, "-") && len(a) > 1
      // one or more short flags; a value-taking one takes the rest
      let k = 1
      while k < len(a)
        let s = str_slice(a, k, k + 1)
        let f = cli_find(cur, s, true)
        if f == null
          return cli_error(cur, str_concat("unknown flag -", s))
        end
        k = k + 1
        if f.kind == CLI_BOOL
          f.bval = true
          f.given = true
        else
          let val = str_slice(a, k, len(a))
          if val == ""
            if i >= len(args)
              return cli_error(cur, str_concat3("-", s, str_concat3(" needs a value (", f.meta, ")")))
            end
            val = args[i]
            i = i + 1
          end
          if !cli_set(cur, f, str_concat("-", s), val)
            return false
          end
          k = len(a)
        end
      end
    else
      // a positional argument, or the subcommand
      let sub: ptr Cli = null
      if vec_len(cur.args) == 0 && !flags_done
        for k = 0 to vec_len(cur.cmds) - 1
          let s = vec_get(cur.cmds, k) as ptr Cli
          if s.name == a
            sub = s
          end
        end
      end
      if sub != null
        cur = sub
        c.chosen = sub
        sub.chosen = sub
      else
        vec_push_str(cur.args, a)
      end
    end
  end
  // check the positional arguments
  let need = 0
  let most = 0
  let rest = false
  for k = 0 to vec_len(cur.specs) - 1
    let s = vec_get(cur.specs, k) as ptr CliArg
    if s.rest
      rest = true
    else
      most = most + 1
      if s.required
        need = most
      end
    end
  end
  if vec_len(cur.cmds) > 0 && cur == c && vec_len(c.specs) == 0 && vec_len(c.args) > 0
    return cli_error(cur, str_concat("unknown command ", str_quote(vec_get_str(c.args, 0))))
  end
  if vec_len(cur.args) < need
    let missing = vec_get(cur.specs, vec_len(cur.args)) as ptr CliArg
    return cli_error(cur, str_concat3("missing <", missing.name, ">"))
  end
  if !rest && vec_len(cur.args) > most
    return cli_error(cur, str_concat("unexpected argument ", str_quote(vec_get_str(cur.args, most))))
  end
  return true
end

fn cli_bool(c: ptr Cli, name: str) -> bool
  return cli_must(c, name).bval
end

fn cli_str(c: ptr Cli, name: str) -> str
  return cli_must(c, name).sval
end

fn cli_int(c: ptr Cli, name: str) -> int
  return cli_must(c, name).ival
end

fn cli_given(c: ptr Cli, name: str) -> bool
  return cli_must(c, name).given
end

fn cli_args(c: ptr Cli) -> ptr Vec
  return c.args
end

fn cli_get(c: ptr Cli, name: str) -> str
  let n = 0
  for k = 0 to vec_len(c.specs) - 1
    let s = vec_get(c.specs, k) as ptr CliArg
    if s.name == name
      if s.rest
        return str_join_from(c.args, n, " ")
      end
      if n < vec_len(c.args)
        return vec_get_str(c.args, n)
      end
      return ""
    end
    n = n + 1
  end
  return ""
end

fn cli_command(c: ptr Cli) -> str
  if c.chosen == null || c.chosen == c
    return ""
  end
  return c.chosen.name
end

fn cli_sub(c: ptr Cli) -> ptr Cli
  if c.chosen == null
    return c
  end
  return c.chosen
end

fn cli_usage(c: ptr Cli) -> str
  let b = sb_new()
  sb_add(b, c.path)
  if c.about != ""
    sb_add(b, ": ")
    sb_add(b, c.about)
  end
  sb_add(b, "\n\nUsage:\n  ")
  sb_add(b, c.path)
  sb_add(b, " [flags]")
  for k = 0 to vec_len(c.specs) - 1
    let s = vec_get(c.specs, k) as ptr CliArg
    if s.rest
      sb_add(b, str_concat3(" [", s.name, "...]"))
    elif s.required
      sb_add(b, str_concat3(" <", s.name, ">"))
    else
      sb_add(b, str_concat3(" [", s.name, "]"))
    end
  end
  if vec_len(c.cmds) > 0
    sb_add(b, "\n  ")
    sb_add(b, c.path)
    sb_add(b, " <command> [flags]")
  end
  sb_byte(b, '\n')
  let rows = vec_new()
  let helps = vec_new()
  for k = 0 to vec_len(c.specs) - 1
    let s = vec_get(c.specs, k) as ptr CliArg
    if s.help != ""
      vec_push_str(rows, s.name)
      vec_push_str(helps, s.help)
    end
  end
  cli_table(b, "Arguments", rows, helps)
  rows = vec_new()
  helps = vec_new()
  for k = 0 to vec_len(c.cmds) - 1
    let s = vec_get(c.cmds, k) as ptr Cli
    vec_push_str(rows, s.name)
    vec_push_str(helps, s.about)
  end
  cli_table(b, "Commands", rows, helps)
  rows = vec_new()
  helps = vec_new()
  let p = c
  while p != null
    for k = 0 to vec_len(p.flags) - 1
      let f = vec_get(p.flags, k) as ptr CliFlag
      let row = "    "
      if f.short != ""
        row = str_concat3("-", f.short, ", ")
      end
      row = str_concat3(row, "--", f.name)
      if f.kind != CLI_BOOL
        row = str_concat3(row, " ", f.meta)
      end
      let help = f.help
      if f.kind == CLI_STR && f.def != ""
        help = str_concat3(help, " (default ", str_concat(str_quote(f.def), ")"))
      elif f.kind == CLI_INT
        help = str_concat3(help, " (default ", str_concat(f.def, ")"))
      end
      vec_push_str(rows, row)
      vec_push_str(helps, help)
    end
    p = p.parent
  end
  vec_push_str(rows, "-h, --help")
  vec_push_str(helps, "show this help")
  cli_table(b, "Flags", rows, helps)
  return sb_str(b)
end

fn cli_table(b: ptr StrBuf, title: str, rows: ptr Vec, helps: ptr Vec)
  if vec_len(rows) == 0
    return
  end
  let w = 0
  for k = 0 to vec_len(rows) - 1
    if len(vec_get_str(rows, k)) > w
      w = len(vec_get_str(rows, k))
    end
  end
  sb_byte(b, '\n')
  sb_add(b, title)
  sb_add(b, ":\n")
  for k = 0 to vec_len(rows) - 1
    sb_add(b, "  ")
    let h = vec_get_str(helps, k)
    if h == ""
      sb_add(b, vec_get_str(rows, k))
    else
      sb_add(b, str_pad(vec_get_str(rows, k), w))
      sb_add(b, "  ")
      sb_add(b, h)
    end
    sb_byte(b, '\n')
  end
end
```
